personality.description: This person tends to rely on familiar routines, repeats methods that have worked before, and is cautious about trying unfamiliar ideas. They keep a moderate level of order in daily life, using enough structure to stay on track while still leaving room to adjust when needed. In moral dilemmas, they usually weigh choices through a practical, self-protective lens, remain skeptical of others' intentions, and may favor outcomes that preserve their own interests unless the cost to others feels clearly unacceptable. In group discussions, they speak sparingly, prefer small and controlled exchanges, and when they do contribute, their tone is direct, guarded, and likely to challenge weak arguments.
traits: has achieved positions of leadership through exceptional performance and abilities
focuses on fostering positive relationships and teamwork
cares a lot about what others think of them
takes input from others on how tasks should be accomplished
is quick to find common ground between other people's ideas and their own
